turns.customer: I finally took the Ridgeline Low shoes from order #1052 out of the box and the sole is coming away from the upper on the left shoe. Can I get a refund?
turns.reply: I am sorry to hear that the sole on your Ridgeline Low Hiking Shoe is coming away. Because this was delivered 45 days ago, it falls outside our standard 14-day damage reporting window. However, I have escalated your request to a human support team member for further review under ticket #ESC-58, and someone will follow up with you by email, usually within one business day. Thanks for understanding.
